snippet.title: Gangs of Asia is Out Now | Launch Trailer | MicroProse
snippet.description:
Gangs of Asia launches today on Steam. A multiplayer brawler-strategy hybrid where skill-based melee combat meets real-time strategy across vibrant, stylized city districts.

Fight as powerful gang leaders, capture buildings, deploy units and somehow manage to do all of it at once. PvP, co-op, horde mode and free-for-all chaos -all in short, intense matches packed with moments you won't see coming.

Play now → https://store.steampowered.com/app/2382670/Gangs_Of_Asia/
#GangsOfAsia #MicroProse #IndieGame #BrawlerRTS
